name: Marketo
description: Adobe Marketo Engage is a marketing automation platform for lead management, campaigns, programs, assets, scoring, and cross-channel engagement. Organizations use it to coordinate marketing operations and measure how people progress through customer journeys.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Marketo subscription through a customer-owned custom service assigned to a dedicated API-only user with only Read-Only Lead and Read-Only Assets. Relay binds the returned token owner and exposes only two preselected reads: lead ID and timestamps, plus bounded program metadata; personal fields, activities, memberships, other assets, bulk APIs, exports, and all mutations are blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Marketo subscription ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact Munchkin/account ID from the subscription REST and Identity endpoints.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Marketo custom-service client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated customer-owned custom service assigned only Read-Only Lead and Read-Only Assets.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Marketo custom-service client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts this secret and sends it only to the selected subscription Identity endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_API_USER
credentialRequirements.label: Expected API-only user
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact API-only user email that the Identity token scope must return.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_LEAD_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected lead ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one Marketo lead whose ID and timestamps Relay may read.

credentialRequirements.name: MARKETO_PROGRAM_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected program ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one Marketo program whose bounded summary Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected lead summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected lead without exposing personal or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected program summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected program.

allowed.label: Read selected lead summary
allowed.description: Read the selected lead's ID and timestamps while discarding contact, custom, and membership fields.

allowed.label: Read selected program summary
allowed.description: Read the selected program's ID, name, type, status, channel, and workspace while discarding other asset details.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Lead contact fields, activities, memberships, cookies, companies, opportunities, custom objects, tokens, secrets, raw responses, and unselected asset details are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Marketo state
blocked.description: Lead sync, merges, associations, campaign requests, imports, activity creation, asset changes, approvals, administration, and user management are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Marketo access
blocked.description: Other subscriptions, API users, leads, programs, assets, workspaces, partitions, list or search endpoints, paging, bulk APIs, SOAP, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected lead and program through a dedicated two-permission API-only user; personal data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches encrypted customer credentials server-side and mounts exactly two preselected, projected Marketo reads.
Railway attaches encrypted customer credentials server-side and mounts exactly two preselected, projected Marketo reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A Marketo Engage subscription, dedicated API-only user, least-privilege role, custom service, subscription ID, credentials, and staging lead/program IDs are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Marketo administrator must create a customer-owned API-only user with only Read-Only Lead and Read-Only Assets in the required workspace, create its custom service, connect the encrypted credentials and exact IDs through Relay, then validate token-owner binding, both projections, permission denial, replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax before live use.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents Marketo two-legged OAuth custom-service credentials, the subscription Identity endpoint, bearer Authorization headers, one-hour tokens, caching, and token scope as the owning API-only user.
Adobe documents that each custom service inherits one API-only user's roles and recommends granting only the minimum permissions; Read-Only Lead and Read-Only Assets are distinct permissions.
Adobe documents the subscription-specific mktorest.com base URL containing the Munchkin/account ID.
Adobe documents GET /rest/v1/lead/{id}.json and the fields parameter used to request only selected fields.
Adobe documents GET /rest/asset/v1/program/{id}.json and the program metadata returned by that selected-resource endpoint.
Adobe documents response-level errors inside HTTP 200 envelopes, including authentication, permission, rate, quota, and availability codes.
